title: サロン・ド・ボーテ シチー

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: While walking through campus, I hear some lively chatter.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: What is going on with your hair? You've got leaves, twigs—it's literally a bird's nest up there!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: So what?! That's nothing to make a fuss about!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Uh, pretty sure it is… How did it even get like that, anyway?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: I was surprised to see you fall into that pit you made yourself.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: My original plan was for you to fall into it!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: No wonder your hair's a mess in the back.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Oh, Trainer… Well, yeah. I hadn't planned for this to take so long though.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Gold City is apparently trying to fix Shinko Windy's hair. But she seems to be having trouble…

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: You know what would be cool, Windy? If you had her give you a superhero hairstyle!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Hmph! I don't care about no goody two shoes superhero crap! I walk on the dark side!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: But doesn't a strong villain need to look cool too?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Hrngh?! You… You might have a point there!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Don't worry, I won't take up too much of your time. Look, even your tail is all disheveled.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Gold City goes to work on Shinko Windy's hair with her scissors and styling products. I stick around and watch.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Okay… All done. You're good to go.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Ohhhh… It feels so smooth.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: I cut and trimmed the damaged parts while I was at it.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Uh… huh… I see, I see…

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Hehe… I like it! I should let ya play around with my hair again sometime!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Haha… Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: That's so nice! I want City to do my hair too!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: I know, right? Windy's so lucky!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Why don't you two come over? I can do yours too.

text_block_list.name: Both Umamusume
text_block_list.text: What?!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Don't you think Biko and Windy would feel awkward if they were the only ones?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As time goes by, word spreads, and people start pouring in!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Um, is it just me, or is this starting to way get out of hand?!
choice_data_list: You'll manage to get through it… somehow…

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: I beg to differ…

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: I'm rooting for you, City! It's like what Carrot Ranger says, "When your back is to the corner, there's only one way out!"

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Bite adversity where it hurts! Grawr, rawr!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Welp… I guess I'm the one who started this whole mess in the first place.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Ohhh, fine! I'll power through this!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Done… What do you think?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume C
text_block_list.text: Whoa… This is amazing! I wasn't sure what to do with my curly hair.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: You've got nice curls, so I tried something to help highlight them.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume C
text_block_list.text: Yeah, yeah! Thank you so much!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: And so, another Umamusume is saved.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Amazing work, City! You're a hero for fighting so admirably!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Yes, yes, thank you. Don't expect me to be doing this again any time soon though.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I can hear the exhaustion in her voice, but she also seems somewhat pleased with what she's done.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Okay, hold on, City! Help is on its way! Hang in there!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: All right, all right! Everyone wait your turn! Line up here if you want a haircut!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Hey! You over there! Stay behind the line so you don't block the walkway!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: City, I have prepared these for you.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Shing!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Having sharpened these scissors myself, I can guarantee precision in their cut. I hope they will serve you well.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: …Thanks.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Um, why'd you call these two?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Bamboo was chasing after me yelling something about violations!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: B-but when I explained the situation, they said they were both willing to help!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: I… see… I mean, I do appreciate the help, but…

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: I'm still the only one doing the cutting!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With the right staffing, well-sharpened scissors, and lively cheers of support, Gold City manages to pull through.
